neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal tek seferi iniş eylemine bağlar ve rahatsızlık anlamına da sahiptir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal sabit bir söyleyişte geliş sayısını bir veya iki olarak bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir olayın sayılabilir tek tek gerçekleşmeleri iki dalda ortaktır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal sayılan iniş olayına, komşu dal ise geri dönüş ve tekrar ettirme düzenine odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal tek bir iniş olayını ve onun bir kez daha oluşunu adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal geri dönen seferi ve bir şeyi tekrar tekrar yapma eylemini temel alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir olayın tekrar etmesi ve ayrı seferler halinde sayılması iki dalda bulunur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal olayın bir kez oluşunu adlandırır; komşu dal hareketin kendisini ve farklı gerçekleşme biçimlerini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal inişi tek bir sayılabilir olay olarak sınırlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal inişin yönünü, konaklama sonucunu, yağmuru ve ağır ilerlemeyi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Aşağı inme eylemi iki dalın ortak temelidir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: النزلة المرة الواحدة؛ ولقد رآه نزلة أخرى أي مرة أخرى (ayn)؛ النزلة كالزكام؛ ولقد رآه نزلة أخرى قالوا مرة أخرى (sihah)؛ النزلة المرة الواحدة من النزول (tahdhib)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak içeriği inişi tek bir gerçekleşme olarak sayar ve bir kez daha yapısını tekrar örneği olarak açıklar; ayrıca aynı biçimin soğuk algınlığına benzer bir rahatsızlık için kullanıldığını belirtir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النزلة بمعنى المرة الواحدة من النزول، وتفسير نزلة أخرى بمرة أخرى، ومنه عند بعضهم النزلة كالزكام بوصفها عارضة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه النزول المستمر أو المنزل والمكان إلا من جهة وقوع مرة واحدة.

branches.branch_image_ar: المكان الذي يظهر فيه أثر النزول

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız kaynakta verilen belirli yer anlatımlarını topluca açıklamak için kullanılır; bağımsız bir yer adı değildir.

error_profile.preserves: Yer kapsamını ve akış, konaklanma ile yer biçimi arasındaki seçenekli nitelikleri korur.

concept_gloss.text: akış, konaklanma veya biçim özelliğiyle nitelenen yer

concept_map.definition: Belirli yer anlatımları, bir araziyi az yağmurda bile hızla su akıtması, sık konaklanması, geniş ve uzak olması ya da yerleşmeye ve otlatmaya elverişliliği bakımından niteler. Ayrı bir kullanım dar vadiyi adlandırır.

facets.statement: Anlam yalnız belirli yer nitelemelerinde ortaya çıkar ve yalın biçim için tek bir genel yer anlamı kurmaz.
Sert bir arazi veya yer, az yağmurda bile hızla su akıtmasıyla nitelenir.
Bir yer sık konaklanması, geniş ve uzak olması ya da yerleşmeye ve otlatmaya elverişliliğiyle nitelenir.
Ayrı bir yer anlatımında vadinin dar bölümü adlandırılır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Arazinin sertliği yüzünden küçük bir yağmurdan sonra hızla yüzey akışı oluştuğu kullanımda geçerlidir.

error_profile.loses: Sık konaklanma, genişlik, otlaklılık ve dar vadi anlamlarını kapsamaz.
error_profile.preserves: Sert zemini, az yağmuru ve hızlı su akışını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.text: az yağmurda bile hızla su akıtan sert arazi

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yerin insanların sıkça indiği ya da yerleşme ve otlatmaya elverişli olduğu kullanımda geçerlidir.

error_profile.loses: Hızlı su akışı, geniş ve uzak yer ile dar vadi anlamlarını kapsamaz.
error_profile.preserves: Sık konaklanma ile yerleşme ve otlatmaya elverişlilik özelliklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yapının vadi türünü özellikle darlığıyla adlandırdığı sınırlı kullanımda geçerlidir.

error_profile.loses: Diğer arazi ve konaklama niteliklerini bütünüyle dışarıda bırakır.
error_profile.preserves: Vadi alanını ve onun dar olma özelliğini eksiksiz korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yalın ve genel bir yer anlamı çıkarılmamalı; her nitelik yalnız kendisini taşıyan yer anlatımı içinde korunmalıdır.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir 'iniş izi taşıyan yer' anlamı kurmaz; yalnız belirli yer nitelemelerinde hızlı su akıtma, sık konaklanma, geniş ve uzak olma, otlaklı yerleşim yeri olma ya da dar vadi olma özelliklerini sıralar. Dal yapısal olarak korunabilir, fakat bu yapıya bağlı yer nitelemeleri dizisi olarak yeniden çerçevelenmelidir.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: az yağmurda bile hızla su akıtan sert arazi
sık konaklanan, geniş uzak, otlaklı veya suyu çabuk akan yer

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal bütünüyle belirli yer nitelemelerine bağlıdır; hızlı akış, sık konaklanma, genişlik, otlaklılık ve vadi darlığı yalın biçimin genel anlamı yapılamaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; yayımlananlar arazi türü, su akışı, geniş alan ve konaklama yeriyle olan gerçek sınırları gösterir, özel yer adları ve uzak alan adayları dışarıda bırakılmıştır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Geniş arazi ve vadi betimlemeleri aynı coğrafi alandadır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yerin çeşitli niteliklerini anlatır; komşu dal yerin kendisini veya ondan gelişen dereceyi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yerin akış, sıklık, genişlik, otlaklılık veya darlık özelliklerini yapıya bağlı biçimde niteler.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İnsanların inip kalabildiği bir yer iki dalda ortak olabilir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: مكان نزل ينزل فيه كثيرا (maqayis)؛ أرض نزلة ومكان نزل إذا كانت تسيل من أدنى مطر لصلابتها (sihah)؛ طعام نزل وأرض نزلة ومكان نزل سريع السيل؛ مكان نزل ينزل فيه كثيرا؛ مكان نزل واسع بعيد؛ مكان نزل إذا كان محلالا مربا؛ النزل من الأودية الضيق منها (tahdhib)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak ifadesi yer nitelemelerini tek yapıda toplar: sertlik nedeniyle az yağmurda hızlı su akıtma, sık konaklanma, geniş ve uzak olma, yerleşme ile otlatmaya elverişlilik ve dar vadi anlamları ayrı ayrı korunur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أوصاف أرض نزلة ومكان نزل إذا أريد سرعة السيل من أدنى مطر، أو كثرة النزول به، أو أوصاف المكان الواسع البعيد أو المحلال المرب أو الضيق من الأودية.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه المنزل الدار أو المنزلة المرتبة إلا إذا كان الوصف للمكان نفسه.

text.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ ٱللَّهُ إِنِّى مُنَزِّلُهَا عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَمَن يَكْفُرْ بَعْدُ مِنكُمْ فَإِنِّىٓ أُعَذِّبُهُۥ عَذَابًۭا لَّآ أُعَذِّبُهُۥٓ أَحَدًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

baseline.text: Allah dedi ki: Ben onu size indireceğim. Bundan sonra sizden kim inkâr ederse ona dünyalarda hiç kimseye etmediğim bir azap edeceğim.

findings.text: İstenen işaret indirildikten sonra onu örtmek, belirsizliği azalttığı için sonraki inkârın sorumluluğunu ağırlaştırır.
Benzersiz bir talebin karşılığı, onu reddeden için benzersiz bir sonuçla eşleşir.

activation_trace.role: Caused descent and delivery supply the event that changes the recipients' evidentiary position.
Denial and obstruction of acknowledged truth supply the offense after delivery.
Succession after a prior event makes the descent a liability boundary.
Painful punishment, repeated as verb-noun-verb, supplies the consequence and gives it emphatic density.

changed_reading.after: Delivery creates a post-event liability threshold: the punished condition is denial after receipt, not uncertainty before receipt.
changed_reading.before: A promise of descent followed by a general warning against unbelief.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The caused descent, followed by fa-man, ba'du, kufr, and the repeated punishment root.
baseline_models.mechanism: The divine utterance commits the object to delivery; its arrival creates a temporal threshold, and denial after that threshold activates the stated sanction.

activation_trace.role: Provision prepared for a guest makes the descended object readable as hosted gift.
Covering a blessing turns post-receipt kufr into ingratitude toward the giver.
Punitive pain becomes the response to a gift received and then denied.

changed_reading.after: The object can already be heard as guest-provision, making kufr a breach of gratitude and hospitality.
changed_reading.before: The object is unspecified and kufr is only doctrinal disbelief.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Munazziluha, yakfur, and the ensuing punishment.
baseline_models.mechanism: The descent root can present the object as provision prepared for a guest, while kufr can cover a blessing; the warning can therefore concern betrayal of received hospitality as well as propositional denial.

activation_trace.role: Repeated punishment supplies the event being compared across all others.
Ahad under negation exhausts every possible comparator rather than naming one individual.
A distinguishing mark supplies an exploratory way to hear the worlds as the field across which this case is singularly marked.

changed_reading.after: The punishment is also a singular identifying mark, with no comparator anywhere in the stated world-field.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The triple use of the punishment root in 'a punishment with which I punish no one among the worlds.'
baseline_models.mechanism: Negated ahad exhausts the comparison class, while the marker branch of the worlds-root makes the sanction not merely intense but distinguishing across the widest named field.

activation_trace.role: An edible share or provision begins the pericope's treatment of food as a governed gift.
An apportioned gift identifies consumable goods as received provision rather than autonomous possession.
A test that reveals condition makes accessible food-material an evidentiary trial.
Afterward succession supplies the earlier legal threshold echoed by the focus.
Punitive pain completes the earlier offense-after-threshold consequence.
Actual delivery raises the focus test from reachable provision to a sign brought upon the recipients.
Denial of truth intensifies the earlier transgression into an evidentiary rupture.

changed_reading.after: The climax of progressive provision-tests: greater access to a requested gift produces a sharper post-receipt liability.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier consumable provision is repeatedly governed as a test, and 5:94 supplies the same whoever-offends-afterward-punishment frame. The focus ayah escalates from reachable game and transgression to a requested descended provision and kufr, and from painful punishment to an unmatched one.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the recurring provision-test sequence and the close conditional syntax; I infer a deliberate escalation in evidentiary access and liability. A live alternative is that 5:94 contributes only a common warning formula.
structural_cues: 5:87-96 repeatedly joins food or game, divine provision, protective conduct, breach, and consequence.
5:94 and 5:115 share a whoever-offends-afterward-punishment sequence, while 5:115 intensifies both offense and sanction.

activation_trace.role: Expiatory covering supplies a reparative use of the same root later used for disbelief.
Feeding others is the material operation by which the earlier breach is covered.
A second food-law expiation reinforces compensatory covering as an established repair pattern.
Food for the needy again materializes repair through feeding.
The focus reverses covering from removal of fault to concealment or denial of manifest truth.
Guest-provision makes the reparative-versus-culpable covering contrast specifically food-shaped.

changed_reading.after: Kufr becomes an anti-expiatory reversal: where food previously covered a breach, the recipient now covers the divine food-sign.
changed_reading.before: Kufr is a generic label for disbelief after a miracle.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier food-law breaches receive kaffara, a covering of fault enacted through feeding; the focus instead uses yakfur for covering the descended sign itself. Food shifts from the means of reparative covering to the object around which culpable covering occurs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shared root and repeated feeding remedies; I infer an intentional semantic reversal between covering fault and covering a sign. The alternative is that kaffara and kufr should remain separate conventional senses with no local wordplay.
structural_cues: Both 5:89 and 5:95 specify food-based compensatory schedules for bounded breaches.
The focus retains the food setting and the k-f-r root but stipulates a conditional sanction rather than a compensatory schedule.

activation_trace.role: Questioning and requesting initiate a disclosure for which the requester becomes responsible.
The emergence of what was hidden supplies the transition from uncertainty to exposed evidence.
Ongoing delivery links asking to disclosure during something sent down.
A prior community's request supplies the explicit precedent for self-requested evidence.
Their subsequent disbelief supplies the exact failure anticipated in the focus.
Afterward closes the request-disclosure cycle before liability begins.

changed_reading.after: Ba'du marks completion of a warned, voluntarily initiated request-disclosure cycle, so the liability is partly self-incurred.
changed_reading.before: Ba'du merely means later than the descent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet first warns that requested disclosure can trouble its requesters, then recalls people who asked for a feminine object and became disbelievers in it. The table request and the focus promise of descending it instantiate that warned sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated request-disclosure-kufr sequence and feminine pronouns; I infer that the earlier warning frames the table episode without asserting an identical antecedent. The alternative is a broad thematic recurrence rather than a precise foreshadowing.
structural_cues: 5:102 uses a feminine singular object in both asking for it and becoming disbelievers in it; 5:112-115 repeats a feminine table and the promise to descend it.
The sequence runs warning about requests, precedent of post-request kufr, present request, promised disclosure, then post-disclosure kufr.

activation_trace.role: Requested descent activates the guest-provision branch and makes the table a hosted meal.
A tray or table bearing food resolves the focus pronoun to a communal edible object.
Actual eating makes bodily receipt one declared purpose of the sign.
Settling into reassurance supplies the affective result the requesters say the sign should produce.
Fulfillment of word by deed supplies the truth claim the table is asked to verify.
Presence with direct observation makes the recipients prospective witnesses, not remote hearers.
A manifest sign makes the table's evidentiary function explicit.
Apportioned giving names the meal as divine provision and reinforces the host-gift mechanism.
Covering a blessing becomes the breach after every requested mode of assurance has been supplied.

changed_reading.after: Disbelief would repudiate a hosted sign the recipients requested and whose evidentiary success criteria they specified themselves.
changed_reading.before: Disbelief follows an externally imposed miracle.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pronoun is resolved as a food-laden table requested from above and named as provision and a sign. Its requesters state the outcomes they seek: eating, settled hearts, verified truthfulness, and witness. Descent therefore fulfills both divine hospitality and a self-declared evidentiary contract.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the table, provision, sign, and the requesters' stated aims; I treat those aims as a self-set burden of proof that fulfillment discharges. A live alternative is that they are motives rather than a binding evidentiary contract.
structural_cues: The request says 'upon us' in 5:112 and 5:114; the answer shifts to 'upon you' in 5:115, transferring the requested object into recipient responsibility.
The declared chain is bodily receipt, affective settlement, knowledge of fulfilled truth, and public witness before the warning says 'afterward.'

activation_trace.role: Manifest appearance supplies proofs whose visibility is conceded even while their meaning is contested.
Denial of truth supplies the response to already manifest proofs.
Magic as diversion and deception supplies the rival label used to neutralize a sign.
The table's designation as a manifest sign makes the earlier recoding pattern available to the focus.
Focus kufr can therefore be active obstruction of a sign's disclosed meaning.

changed_reading.after: Kufr may concede the event yet cover its force by redescribing the manifest sign as deception.
changed_reading.before: Kufr means refusing to believe that the descended event happened.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the table dialogue, manifest proofs are met by kufr through relabeling them as evident magic. Since the table is explicitly called a sign, post-descent kufr can operate as interpretive recoding of acknowledged visibility rather than simple denial that an event occurred.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an earlier mechanism for resisting visible proofs; I infer that it exemplifies how post-table kufr could work. The alternative is that the table's rejection would take a different form not specified here.
structural_cues: 5:110 places manifest proofs, kufr, and the counter-label 'magic' in one response sequence.
5:114 designates the requested table as a sign before 5:115 warns against kufr after its descent.

activation_trace.role: A bounded span identified as the gathering day supplies the judicial temporal frame.
Gathering dispersed messengers supplies the assembly in which testimony is reviewed.
Spoken question and answer initiate the judgment dialogue that leads into the recalled exchange.
A second divine saying closes the extended speech sequence as a judgment pronouncement.
Truth of speech supplies the criterion vindicated on that day and recalls the table's truth-verification aim.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies the favorable judgment counterpart to the focus punishment.
The focus saying becomes an evidentiary utterance preserved within the larger divine-human dialogue.

changed_reading.after: A historical promise that also sounds as a recorded exhibit in the final review of claims, witnesses, and truthfulness.
changed_reading.before: A chronological answer delivered only at the moment of the table request.

context_deltas.mechanism: The table exchange stands inside a sequence opened by the day God gathers the messengers and closed by another divine saying about the day truthfulness benefits the truthful. The focus utterance can function both as the original promise and as archived testimony replayed in final accounting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the judgment opening, repeated divine speech frames, and the truthfulness close; I infer that the table promise is replayable evidence inside final accounting. The alternative is a historical flashback merely juxtaposed with, rather than embedded in, the judgment scene.
structural_cues: 5:109 opens with the day of gathering and interrogated responses; 5:110 and 5:116 each begin a divine address to Jesus around the table exchange.
5:115 and 5:119 both begin with 'God said,' and 5:119 explicitly returns to 'this day' and truthfulness.

activation_trace.role: Punitive pain is restated as an if-clause under divine action rather than human assignment.
Servitude and ownership keep the persons under God's claim even in the punishment branch.
Covering sin and shielding its bearer preserves forgiveness as language in the final adjudicative scene.
Sovereign dominion reserves classification and execution of judgment to God.
The focus retains a severe first-person sanction, but only under its stated post-descent kufr condition.

changed_reading.after: A severe divine conditional sentence whose predicate must not be broadened beyond actual post-sign kufr and whose adjudication remains God's.
changed_reading.before: An automatic and humanly classifiable doom for all who encounter the table.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby final dialogue places punishment and forgiveness as alternatives concerning God's servants, and the close reserves dominion to God. This weakens any expansion of the focus threat into a humanly administered or indiscriminate verdict, without erasing its explicit condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conditional threat, conditional punishment-forgiveness language, and sovereign ownership; I infer a scope check against reader-made universalization. A live alternative is that 5:118 concerns a different category and does not soften the certainty of 5:115 for anyone who meets its predicate.
structural_cues: 5:115 says 'whoever disbelieves afterward,' restricting the sanction to a predicate rather than every recipient.
5:118 pairs 'if You punish' with 'if You forgive,' and 5:120 closes with God's exclusive dominion.

remaining_uncertainties: Whether ba'du presupposes eating from the table or only its descent.
Whether 5:109-119 embeds the whole table exchange in the judgment scene or juxtaposes a historical flashback with it.
How much weight the sweetness-punishment and movement-settlement branch counterpoints can bear beyond contained lexical play.
Whether the forgiveness language of 5:118 addresses the same predicate as 5:115 or a broader, categorically different population.
strongest_changes: The exact 5:94 offense-afterward-punishment frame turns 5:115 into an escalated culmination of provision-tests.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ}} ({{tr:al-ʿālamīna}}) is the ayah's final landing point. As a definite plural after the preposition, it completes the phrase no one from the worlds and gives the punishment comparison its maximum domain. The sound masculine plural can treat the worlds as populated communities of accountable beings, while the word's knowledge and sign associations remain secondary color: locally it is the total comparison set. The closing also reverses the worlds-frame of 5:20, where unmatched gift becomes, here, unmatched punishment.
